title: unverifiable-evidence-freshness-treated-as-current

proposition.statement: A relying system must not treat evidence as current when the freshness needed for the decision context cannot be established from available temporal or lifecycle information.

preconditions: The relying decision requires evidence to be current within a bounded or otherwise meaningful freshness condition.
The available evidence does not establish when the relevant state was observed, produced, or last verified.
The relying system cannot otherwise establish that no material state change has occurred.

trigger.statement: The relying system evaluates current state while the age or freshness of required evidence is unresolved.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence establishing the freshness condition required for the relying decision.
Evidence identifying relevant observation, production, verification, or effective times.
Evidence sufficient to determine whether a material state change could invalidate the evidence used.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS for a current-state proposition when required evidence freshness cannot be established.
The system assumes evidence remains current indefinitely because no newer evidence was successfully retrieved.

references.note: Repository judgment record for the evidence failure tranche.
